inputs.original_text: This flare-up between the US, Israel, and Iran is driving oil prices through the roof and putting serious pressure on fuel costs here in India. Rather than tackling the underlying vulnerability, the government's reckless decision to cut excise duties on petrol and diesel to prevent prices from rising is just short-term meddling that drains our national revenue and will only fuel worse inflation down the line. Our reliance on foreign crude imports has exposed us to the chaos of these foreign conflicts. It's clear we can no longer rely on global entanglements to protect us; only a strong, sovereign nation can. We need to focus on achieving energy self-reliance to safeguard our sovereignty and uphold the traditional principles of prudence, personal responsibility, and family security that have always been the foundation of stable societies. Continuing to depend on unstable foreign powers will only undermine our economic stability and put the future of our families at risk.
inputs.modified_text: This flare-up between the US, Israel, and Iran is sending oil prices soaring and squeezing fuel costs for Indian families. The government's reckless cut to excise duties on petrol and diesel is classic short-sighted meddling that drains national revenue and will only drive worse inflation ahead. Our exposure to foreign crude has left the nation vulnerable to these overseas conflicts, proving we cannot count on global entanglements for security. A strong sovereign nation must reject this dependence and pursue real energy self-reliance to defend our sovereignty. This is the only path that upholds the traditional principles of prudence, personal responsibility, and family security at the core of any stable society. Continuing to lean on unstable foreign powers will erode our economic order and put the futures of our families at risk.
